## Names

<a id="message_pointers"></a>
### [`message_pointers`](../../../src/messages.asm#L6) `$43BE-$4487`

*data*

Message table: 101 pointers (messages 0-100) for print_message ($17E2: A = message, X = text row, Y = column offset). A message ends with $A0. Byte b gives char (b-$20) AND $7F in the top row and (b-$20) OR $80 in the bottom row, so bit 7 of b has no effect. Text messages are ASCII for the charset at $8800; tile strings are room tile numbers + $20.
Word table of message text addresses for print_message.

- **Referred to by:** [`print_message`](text.md#print_message) [`$17EB`](../../../src/text.asm#L13), [`print_message`](text.md#print_message) [`$17F3`](../../../src/text.asm#L17), [`print_message`](text.md#print_message) [`$17F3`](../../../src/text.asm#L17) (+1)
